homeAddBody: Take a photo of your plant and Broto fills in its care. You can also add it without a photo.
homeTabsBody: Tap to switch, or swipe the screen sideways.
homeAnalyzeBody: One photo tells you the species, what is wrong and what to do.
homeChatBody: He knows your plants and answers about watering, light, pests and pots.
homeBellBody: When a plant needs you, the reminder is also kept here.
tasksDaysBody: Swipe the days to see what is coming. The dot marks days with tasks.
tasksGroupBody: Tap the circle to complete. Tap the task name to change how often or when it reminds you.
plantsCardTitle: Each plant has its own page
plantsCardBody: Tap to see what it needs today, its care routine and past analyses.
plantsGroupBody: Group plants by room or however you like, such as Living room or Balcony.
analysesRowBody: Tap to review the result. Save it to a plant so it stays on the list.
